title: Climbing Stairs
statement:
You are climbing a staircase of `n` steps. Each time you can climb 1 or 2 steps. Return the number of distinct ways to reach the top.

Example: n = 3 -> 3 (1+1+1, 1+2, 2+1)
hints: How many ways to reach step i? It only depends on steps i-1 and i-2.
This is the Fibonacci recurrence: ways[i] = ways[i-1] + ways[i-2].
You only need the last two values — O(1) space is enough.
